title: Stylish & Cool - Walk to Downtown & Broadway!
description:
Best Location! Stylish & Cool. Walk to Broadway and everything Downtown Nashville has to offer. Bridgestone Arena, Ryman Auditorium & Titans Stadium are also within walking distance. Full Kitchen with coffee bar - 2 parking spaces-one is gated. Washer & Dryer within the unit. Strong Wi-Fi and a 50" TV. Balcony with seating. As good as it gets if you are coming to Nashville. The famous Husk southern restaurant is steps from the unit. Walk to coffee shops and The Goat SOBRO. Close to everything!

The space
The condo is a 1 bedroom that sleeps six. The bedroom has a queen bed. The living area has a king bed and a queen pullout couch.

Guest access
Entire condo with 2 parking spaces included. One space is gated - there will be a yellow pass and gate key on the round table once you enter. Make sure to leave it on the table upon departure. The other space is open parking in the rear of the condo.
